desc: Derive an algebraic characterization: horizontal and vertical edge variables are determined by one seed per row/column; Type-B cells impose XOR inequalities between seeds.
Prove that row/column Type-A parity conditions are necessary and sufficient for toroidal closure.
Implement weighted DSU with parity for all Type-B constraints and count consistent assignments.
Verify the characterization against the sample cases and small brute-force enumerations.
Produce the final Python solution with linear time and memory handling for total grid size up to \(10^6\).
